consent.title: Data protection and privacy
consent.intro: Before you continue, please read how SOLIDARIS uses your personal information.
notice: The SOLIDARIS team collects your name, email address, institution, position, country and discipline, the projects you take part in, your role on each project, and the work you record (evidence, ratings, comments, decisions).
We use this information only to run the platform: to manage your account, coordinate projects, keep an accountable record of assessment decisions, and contact you about your projects.

Your information is stored with our hosting provider (Supabase) in the United Kingdom. It is visible only to you, the members of projects you join, and authorised administrators. Every change to project records is kept in an audit log.

We handle personal information in line with the data protection laws that apply to our partners, including the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023, the EU and UK General Data Protection Regulation, and Canada's Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA).

You can ask for a copy of your personal information or ask us to delete it. If you leave, we anonymise your personal details but keep the audit record of project decisions, which research integrity requires.
consent.processing: I agree that SOLIDARIS may collect and use my personal information to run my account and the projects I take part in.
consent.handling: I understand my information is stored securely for this purpose, is visible to my project teams and administrators, and that project decisions are kept in an audit log.
consent.email: Send me email notifications about my projects (invitations, reviews, decisions). You can turn this off at any time.
consent.draftNote: This notice is awaiting legal review before public launch.
